# GitHub repository profile — proposed settings (not applied by this PR)

The public repository currently has no short description, topic tags, recognized root project license or release. These are GitHub **repository settings**, not ordinary Markdown edits, so maintainers should review them before updating the live profile.

**Suggested description:**

> CampusPool — SE + DBMS campus carpooling demo with route-aware ride matching, transactional MySQL bookings, Next.js frontend and reproducible tests.

**Suggested GitHub topics:** `campus-carpooling`, `software-engineering`, `dbms`, `nextjs`, `laravel`, `mysql`, `openstreetmap`, `student-project`.

Do **not** tag the project `ola-maps` until the Ola integration exists. Do **not** mark it as a production transportation service, a live-payment application or a university-endorsed app.

**License:** Ask the actual copyright owners to decide the root license with their course constraints, while respecting the separate upstream Carpoolear GPLv3 and OSM ODbL obligations. A generic `LICENSE` pasted into this repo without that review would be misleading.

**Preview and release:** Add two sanitized screenshots from an up-to-date verified demo, a short walkthrough, and a course/demo tag after owner approval. The 2026-10-27 video is historical and predates the latest UI; avoid presenting it as a current release.
